body:
## Recent Activity

The lookback window (2026-05-15 ~11:49 UTC → 2026-05-16 ~11:49 UTC) was dominated by completing the two-stacked-PR caption feature planned in issue [#37](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/issues/37).

**PR #41 (caption-infra):** `lolipopshock` triggered `/orchestrate` on PR #41 mid-day. Sepo applied a one-line `ignorePatterns` revert (the blocking defect from yesterday's stopped run), then added ARIA keyboard navigation and `window.addCleanup` SPA lifecycle hooks. Final dual-agent synthesis verdict: **SHIP**. All prior BLOCKING and WARNING findings are resolved.

**PR #44 (caption-workflow):** Sepo implemented the full `agent-caption-update.yml` workflow (yt-dlp download → VTT→markdown → Claude Haiku EN→ZH translation → branch + PR), plus `.agent/scripts/vtt-to-md.js` and `.agent/scripts/translate-caption.js`. A review found a command-injection vulnerability (inputs embedded directly in `run:` shells), a `vtt-to-md.js` remainder-offset bug, and a missing type guard. A fix-pr pass addressed all five action items; the second review confirmed resolution. Final verdict: **SHIP**.

**Issue #37 orchestration:** Both planned stages (caption-infra #40 → PR #41; caption-workflow #43 → PR #44) completed with SHIP verdicts. The orchestrator stopped cleanly (`done`); merging the stacked PRs is the remaining human step.
